name: MonarchPermissionMatrix
title: PermissionMatrix
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.Checkbox (grid cells), androidx.compose.material3.PrimaryScrollableTabRow with Tab (role picker), MonarchCheckboxRow (one role at a time), androidx.compose.foundation.layout.BoxWithConstraints
summary: Which permissions each role has: roles by permissions, edited with checkboxes or shown read only, grouped, with cells that cannot change and say why.
whenToUse: On a roles settings screen, to show and edit which permissions each role of a workspace grants.
whenNotToUse: To give one person a role, use MonarchRolePicker. To show the permissions an AI assistant asks for, use MonarchAiPermissionScope.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPermissionMatrix(roles: List<MonarchPermissionMatrixRole>, permissions: List<MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission>, value: Map<String, Set<String>>, onValueChange: (Map<String, Set<String>>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, layout: MonarchPermissionMatrixLayout = MonarchPermissionMatrixLayout.Automatic, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, lockReason: ((roleId: String, permissionId: String) -> String?)? = null, labels: MonarchPermissionMatrixLabels = MonarchPermissionMatrixLabels())
class MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: String, label: String, description: String? = null)
class MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: String, label: String, description: String? = null, group: String? = null)
enum class MonarchPermissionMatrixLayout { Automatic, Grid, ByRole }

class MonarchPermissionMatrixLabels(permissionHeader: String? = null, rolePicker: String? = null, cellLabel: ((permission: String, role: String) -> String)? = null, allowed: String? = null, notAllowed: String? = null, locked: String? = null)

options.name: roles
options.description: The roles, in order: columns of the grid, tabs of the one-role layout.

options.name: permissions
options.description: The permissions, in order. Those with the same group are listed together under its heading, groups in the order they first appear.

options.name: value
options.description: The granted permission ids by role id. A missing role has none; a role id that is not in roles is kept and ignored.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the whole new value when a cell is toggled.

options.name: title
options.description: A heading above the matrix, with the heading semantics.

options.name: layout
options.description: Automatic shows the grid when every column fits the width and the font scale is at most 1.3, and one role at a time otherwise; Grid always shows the grid, scrolling sideways; ByRole always shows one role at a time.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the cells and role tabs can be used, for example false while saving.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Shows a check or a dash, read as Allowed or Not allowed, instead of checkboxes.

options.name: lockReason
options.description: Why a cell cannot change, or null when it can. An empty string uses "This can’t be changed".

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces the column heading, the role tabs' name, the cell name, Allowed, Not allowed and the default lock reason.

states.name: grid
states.description: A header row of roles, a divider, group headings and one row per permission with a checkbox per role in 80dp columns.

states.name: one role at a time
states.description: A scrollable tab row of roles, the role's description, then group headings and a MonarchCheckboxRow per permission.

states.name: locked
states.description: The checkbox is disabled; its reason is written under the permission in the grid ("Owner: …") or under the row, and added to the cell's spoken name.

states.name: read only
states.description: A check in the strong success color or a dash in the subtle text color, read as Allowed or Not allowed; in the one-role layout the words are written.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled = false every checkbox and tab uses the disabled colors and cannot be changed.

appearance: Role and permission names use the label and body styles in the default text color, descriptions, group headings and lock reasons the caption and label styles in the muted text color. Checkboxes and tabs are Material 3 in the Monarch theme. All colors are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same names as iOS. The web's controlled and uncontrolled value with onValueChange is hoisted state here: value with onValueChange, which receives the whole new value (the web also passes the changed cell). The web's table has arrow-key grid navigation (WAI-ARIA grid); a phone has no arrow keys, so TalkBack moves cell by cell. A two-axis grid does not fit a phone, so the automatic layout shows one role at a time with a Material 3 tab row, as iOS does with MonarchTabs. Monarch bundles no icons, so a locked cell shows no lock symbol; its reason is written instead. The web's isLocked may return a rich reason; here it is a String. disabled is the enabled parameter.
accessibility: Each grid cell is a Material 3 Checkbox with the checkbox role and on or off state, named "<permission> for <role>" by a replaceable string.
A locked cell is disabled and its reason is part of its spoken name and written on screen.
In the one-role layout each permission is a MonarchCheckboxRow: one element with the label, the description and the reason, and a 48dp target.
Read only, each grid cell is one element named by the cell with Allowed or Not allowed as its state description, so the mark's shape and color are not the only signal.
The title, the permission column heading, role headings and group headings have the heading semantics.
The role tabs are Material 3 tabs with the selected state and 48dp targets.
At font scales above 1.3 the automatic layout shows one role at a time, so no text is cut off.
edgeCases: With no roles, only the title is shown.
A role id in the value that is not in roles is kept in the new value and ignored on screen.
The forced grid scrolls sideways when it is wider than its space.
Locked cells keep whatever the value says; the app decides their value.
The selected tab is remembered across configuration changes and clamped when roles are removed.

examples.title: Editable with locked owner column
examples.template:
MonarchPermissionMatrix(
    roles = listOf(
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id = {{roles.0.id}}, label = {{roles.0.label}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id = {{roles.1.id}}, label = {{roles.1.label}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id = {{roles.2.id}}, label = {{roles.2.label}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id = {{roles.3.id}}, label = {{roles.3.label}}),
    ),
    permissions = listOf(
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = {{permissions.0.id}}, label = {{permissions.0.label}}, group = {{permissions.0.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = {{permissions.1.id}}, label = {{permissions.1.label}}, group = {{permissions.1.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = {{permissions.2.id}}, label = {{permissions.2.label}}, group = {{permissions.2.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = {{permissions.3.id}}, label = {{permissions.3.label}}, description = {{permissions.3.description}}, group = {{permissions.3.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = {{permissions.4.id}}, label = {{permissions.4.label}}, group = {{permissions.4.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = {{permissions.5.id}}, label = {{permissions.5.label}}, group = {{permissions.5.group}}),
    ),
    value = grants,
    onValueChange = { grants = it },
    title = {{caption}},
    lockReason = { role, _ -> if (role == {{lockedRole}}) {{lockReason}} else null },
)
examples.code:
MonarchPermissionMatrix(
    roles = listOf(
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id = "viewer", label = "Viewer"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id = "member", label = "Member"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id = "admin", label = "Admin"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id = "owner", label = "Owner"),
    ),
    permissions = listOf(
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = "records.view", label = "View records", group = "Records"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = "records.edit", label = "Create and edit records", group = "Records"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = "records.delete", label = "Delete records", group = "Records"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = "members.invite", label = "Invite members", description = "Send invitations by email.", group = "Members"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = "members.remove", label = "Remove members", group = "Members"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id = "billing.manage", label = "Manage billing", group = "Workspace"),
    ),
    value = grants,
    onValueChange = { grants = it },
    title = "What each role can do",
    lockReason = { role, _ -> if (role == "owner") "Owners always have every permission." else null },
)

examples.title: Read only, as a grid
examples.code:
MonarchPermissionMatrix(
    roles = listOf(MonarchPermissionMatrixRole("admin", "Admin"), MonarchPermissionMatrixRole("member", "Member")),
    permissions = listOf(MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission("invite", "Invite members")),
    value = mapOf("admin" to setOf("invite")),
    onValueChange = {},
    layout = MonarchPermissionMatrixLayout.Grid,
    readOnly = true,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The phone shows each row as a card: the first column is the card title and every other cell carries its column name as a label, so the column header row is not drawn. TalkBack reads each cell with its column name.
parityExceptions.convention: a table is a list of cards on a phone (Material list-detail), not a header row
